Confirm before casting

  • Ring size. Have the jeweller size the left little finger; the model is set to UK Q as a placeholder.
  • Engraving. The photos show three linked letters across the finger, reading upright when the hand hangs down. Hand cutting from a close-up photo of the old ring will look closer than the CAD lettering.
  • Face size. Estimated from finger width in the photos, so expect ±1 mm.

CAD files for the jeweller

Measurements are estimates read from casual photos. The jeweller can open the STL files in their CAD software and adjust any of these.
